function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace && sed -n '1,240p' repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh && find repo-vul/work-vul/lwan -maxdepth 3 -type f | grep -E 'request_fuzzer|lwan$|\\.a$|\\.so$' | sort"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
mkdir -p $WORK/lwan
cd $WORK/lwan
cmake -GNinja   -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug        -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${CC}"      -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="${CFLAGS}"     $SRC/lwan/
ninja -v liblwan.a
zip -jr $OUT/request_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/lwan/fuzz/corpus/corpus-request-*
for fuzzer in $SRC/lwan/src/bin/fuzz/*_fuzzer.cc; do
        executable=$(basename $fuzzer .cc)
        $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11               -Wl,-whole-archive $WORK/lwan/src/lib/liblwan.a -Wl,-no-whole-archive           -I$SRC/lwan/src/lib $fuzzer             -lFuzzingEngine -lpthread -lz           -o $OUT/$executable
done
repo-vul/work-vul/lwan/src/lib/liblwan.a
